About Legit Security
Legit Security is a well-funded cybersecurity company backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to solve some of the most challenging problems in application security. We help AI-first organizations release software fast, without security slowing them down, by leveraging AI agents to secure code and remediate vulnerabilities automatically. We're leading a new era of AppSec, built for a world where AI writes the code.
﻿About the Role
We're looking for a driven, enterprise-focused Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just close them. You'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, targeting security and development leaders at enterprise accounts across the US. If you thrive in fast-moving environments and know how to navigate a technical buyer, we'd love to meet you.
﻿ You Are
A pipeline builder. You proactively create opportunities through outbound, your network, and market knowledge.
A solution seller. You understand customer challenges and know how to map our platform to real business outcomes.
A strong communicator at the C-level- CISOs, VPs of AppSec, and DevSecOps leaders are your primary targets.
Persistent and process-driven. You can find, navigate, and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
A team player. Comfortable collaborating across sales, marketing, and customer success in a fast-moving startup.
Proficient with tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator, Salesforce, SalesLoft, and Clari.
Requirements
10+ years of sales experience, predominantly in SaaS solution selling to enterprise and larger mid-market accounts.
Strong background in cybersecurity sales- AppSec or DevSecOps experience is a significant advantage.
A network of CISOs, Directors of Application Security, DevOps, or DevSecOps.
Proven track record of overachievement in previous roles.

Remote - US

Modellama.description:
Description
Data Analyst | Modellama
Join a growing data-driven sports-tech company and help shape the next phase of our research team.
About Modellama:
Modellama is a pioneering company that blends advanced statistical modeling, cutting-edge algorithms, and a deep passion for sports—especially soccer. Since 2009, we’ve been transforming data into winning insights by combining data science, expert knowledge, and real-time information processing.
About the Role:
As part of our continued growth and expansion, we’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Research Department. This is a new role within a growing team, offering a unique opportunity to influence how data, models, and insights evolve at Modellama.
What You’ll Do:
Work hands-on with large, evolving datasets to explore patterns, validate hypotheses, and uncover meaningful signals.
Collaborate closely with a growing research team to design, refine, and scale analytical and research methodologies.
Take part in shaping how research questions are defined, explored, and translated into actionable insights.
Build, test, and iterate on advanced logic flows and analytical frameworks to detect key events and behaviors.
Lead exploratory, recurring, and ad hoc analyses — from raw data investigation to clear, insight-driven conclusions.
Continuously challenge assumptions, improve data quality, and explore new tools, techniques, and data sources through experimentation and research accuracy.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear narratives that support strategic and research-driven decisions.
Who You Are:
You’re curious, proactive, and love turning data into action. You think in terms of value, not vanity metrics — and you’re not afraid to experiment, fail, learn, and improve. You take ownership of your work from start to finish, communicate with confidence, and enjoy collaborating with diverse minds.
Requirements
Requirements:
3–5 years of experience as a Data Analyst.
Strong SQL skills (SQL Server).
Programming experience in Python or R.
Solid Knowledge in statistics .
Genuine passion for sports (soccer, basketball, etc.).
Nice to Have:
Interest in FinTech , algorithmic trading , or related fields.

Nebius.description:
About Nebius:
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The role
We are looking for a BI Developer to join the CISO Data Analytics team in Tel Aviv. This role is primarily focused on designing, developing, and maintaining Tableau dashboards and BI products that support decision-making across security operations, risk, compliance, and leadership. Approximately 60–70% of the role will focus on dashboard development, KPI design, data storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
What you'll do:
Develop and deliver Tableau dashboards from requirements through deployment.
Work directly with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and turn them into dashboards.
Help translate business needs into KPIs and reporting metrics.
Maintain and continuously improve existing dashboards, ensuring data quality and stakeholder adoption.
Conduct ad hoc analyses and deep-dives to support business decisions.
Write SQL queries to extract, join, and prepare data.
Requirements
Must have:
3–5 years of experience in a BI, analytics, or data visualisation role, with Tableau as your primary tool for most of that time.
Advanced, hands-on Tableau skills: calculated fields, LOD expressions, parameters, table calculations, performance optimisation, and Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud.
A portfolio of dashboards you built yourself - you should be able to speak in detail about design decisions, data sources and what each dashboard enabled.
SQL: complex queries, joins, window functions and aggregations.
Experience defining KPIs and metrics collaboratively with stakeholders, not just visualising numbers handed to you.
Clear communicator, comfortable presenting findings to non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal English.
Security Domain – Strong Advantage
Experience in a CISO, SOC, GRC, or security operations environment.
Familiarity with security metrics - vulnerability management, incident response, or access control KPIs.
Knowledge of frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or SOC 2.
Experience working with security tooling data (SIEM, EDR, IAM, or ticketing platforms).
Nice to have:
Basic Python for analytics automation (not data engineering).
Awareness of pipeline tools such as dbt or Airflow.
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
What We Offer
High-impact analytics role within a global cybersecurity organisation.
Ownership of dashboards and BI products used by leadership.
Opportunity to influence decision-making through data and analytics.
Benefits & Perks:
Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams
What's it like to work at Nebius:
Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
Equal Opportunity Statement:
Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Nebius.description:
About Nebius:
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The role
Nebius is looking for a Head of Analytics.
As Head of Analytics, you’ll lead the analytics team and strengthen how data is used to support decision-making across the company. Reporting to the VP of Data & Analytics, you’ll translate the broader data strategy into clear priorities, high-quality analytical delivery, and measurable business impact.
You’ll manage and develop teams of analysts and BI, partner closely with senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Operations, and ensure that the company has trusted metrics, actionable insights, and scalable analytical capabilities.
This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You’ll be expected to set direction, create structure, raise analytical standards, and remain closely involved in the company’s most important business questions.
You’re welcome to work in our offices in Tel Aviv, Israel
Your responsibilities will include:
Team leadership and development. Lead, mentor, and develop the analytics team. Set clear expectations, establish ownership, support professional growth, and create a high-performance culture focused on business impact, analytical quality, and accountability.
Analytics strategy execution. Partner with the VP of Data & Analytics to shape the analytics strategy and own its execution, prioritization, and delivery. Translate company goals into a clear analytics roadmap and ensure resources are focused on the highest-impact business needs.
Business partnership. Act as a trusted analytical partner to senior leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Operations. Understand their objectives, challenge assumptions, and help turn strategic questions into measurable decisions and actions.
Decision support and advanced analysis. Lead high-impact analyses across customer behavior, product performance, revenue, retention, pipeline, operational efficiency, and business growth. Ensure findings are translated into clear recommendations rather than presented as data alone.
Metrics and analytical governance. Establish and maintain consistent KPI definitions, business logic, and analytical standards. Ensure stakeholders use trusted and aligned metrics across dashboards, reports, forecasts, and business reviews.
Dashboard and reporting oversight. Guide the design, implementation, and improvement of executive and operational dashboards. Ensure reporting is relevant, reliable, easy to use, and aligned with business priorities.
Self-service analytics. Enable business teams to access and use data independently while maintaining appropriate governance, security, quality, and consistency. Identify where self-service creates value and where centralized analytical support is required.
AI-driven analytics. Help define and implement AI-assisted analytics capabilities that reduce manual reporting, accelerate insight generation, support natural-language access to data, and proactively surface risks or anomalies. Establish clear quality and validation standards for AI-generated outputs.
Cross-functional data collaboration. Work closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, and other technical teams to ensure that analytical datasets, semantic models, and data pipelines support current and future business requirements.
Operating model and prioritization. Build scalable processes for intake, prioritization, delivery, documentation, and stakeholder communication. Balance urgent business requests with strategic initiatives and long-term capability development.
We expect you to have:
A minimum of 15 years' experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related data function within a technology or data-driven company.
At-least 10 to 12 years of experience leading and developing analytics teams, including setting priorities, managing performance, and building strong analytical talent.
Strong business judgment and the ability to connect analytical work to revenue, customer, product, operational, and strategic outcomes.
Experience partnering with senior executives and functional leaders, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
Strong proficiency in SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling, BI platforms, analytical methodologies, and modern data environments.
Experience defining company-level KPIs, metric frameworks, and scalable reporting standards.
Strong analytical foundation, including statistical reasoning, cohort analysis, funnel analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and performance measurement.
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong understanding of data quality, governance, documentation, and the importance of consistent business definitions.
Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-growing environment, manage competing priorities, and create structure where processes are still developing.
It will be an added bonus if you have:
Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Superset.
Familiarity with modern data stacks and technologies such as dbt, Airflow, BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Postgres.
Experience working across multiple business domains, including Product, Go-to-Market, Finance,

Orbit Communication Systems.description:
Description
Orbit Communication Systems is seeking an Engineer specializing in satellite signal analysis and system-level investigation, to join its Ground Systems and Integrated Solutions team.
The role combines RF engineering, satellite communications, system analysis, and operational troubleshooting, with a strong focus on investigating and understanding complex signal behavior in satellite environments.
This role is suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical analysis, problem solving, and working with space-based systems. Satellite Communication knowledge is required.
Responsibilites
Advanced analysis of satellite signals.
Investigation of RF behavior and anomalies.
System-level performance analysis.
Field and lab activities.
Training documentation generation and presentation.
Technical & Professional Requirements
RF and communications fundamentals.
SATCOM system understanding.
Signal and measurement analysis.
Ground segment equipment operation.
General Skills & Professional Abilities
Writing procedures and documentation.
Preparing presentations.
Training and technical briefings.
Requirements
INON DAVIDOBSc in Electrical / Communications Engineering (preferred).
RF / SATCOM experience advantage.
Military technological unit background advantage.
Additional Information
A valid security clearance is required.
Candidates who do not meet all requirements but have strong fundamentals and interest in space are encouraged to apply.
Orbit Communication Systems.title: Satellite Signal Analysis Engineer Israel Associate Full-time

Percepto.description:
Responsibilities
Support the deployment, installation, and conduct the ongoing maintenance of Percepto's systems at client sites.
Troubleshoot, test, repair, and maintain aerial and ground systems.
Independently plan and execute assigned activities, collaborating with internal and external teams to ensure successful completion.
Follow company procedures and protocols and provide feedback for improvement.
Ensure readiness and proper maintenance of all flight and testing equipment and tools
Ensure all tasks are carried out in accordance with schedules and client expectations.
Safely conduct operations, adhering to FAA, other local aviation regulations, OSHA regulations, and customer-specific safety protocols
Maintain proper documentation of all work performed and timely provide status updates as required.
Participate in in-field testing of Percepto’s next-era autonomous robotic systems
Test product capabilities and identify areas for improvement
Requirements
FAA Part 107 preferred, or the ability to pass the exam within the first 30 days of employment (paid for by the company)
Valid U.S. Driver's License and clean driving record (MVR) to operate company-provided field vehicle
Must reside within 50 miles of the Midland, TX operations hub
Safety Credentials: Mention that PEC/SafeLand SAFESTART certification, H2S Clear, and a clean Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)
Daily drive-based travel to client sites & up to 25% flight-based travel
At least 1-2 years of proven technical record operating drones, or 2+ years of industrial technician experience (E&I, wind/solar, aviation mechanics, or diesel/heavy equipment)
At least 2 years of proven technician work experience (electrician, mechanic, assembly, repair )
Ability to work in a fast-paced, flexible environment
Ability to work on some non-routine hours, and willingness to work overtime
Ability to self-learn in a highly dynamic environment
Successfully work both independently and as part of a team
Great customer-facing skills
Strong communication skills – written, verbal, and presentation
Willingness to work out in the field
Self-motivated, self-starter, energetic, assertive
Thermographer certification is a plus
Spanish speaker - an advantage
Physical Requirements:
Ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions( including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and humidity) and work environments where exposure to dust, dirt, and other outdoor elements is common
Ability to lift and carry heavy objects, often ranging from 50 to 100 lbs, sometimes over uneven or rough terrain.
Frequent bending, kneeling, crouching, or squatting to access and work on equipment located at ground level or in confined spaces.
Physical endurance to perform strenuous tasks for extended periods, including working in awkward or uncomfortable positions; reaching and working on equipment inside enclosures, cabinets, or elevated areas.
Repetitive use of hands and fingers to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, and controls. This could include using hand tools, operating equipment, or making precise adjustments.
We offer
Competitive compensation
Company Vehicle & Fuel Card provided for work travel
Benefits: medical/dental/vision with company premium allowance, Health Reimbursement & Savings Accounts, 401(K) Plan
Paid Time Off
Great team and supportive environment
Career growth and opportunity
Why join Percepto We care about the people we work with; we want our team members to grow and develop professionally, to find their jobs rewarding and intellectually stimulating, and of course - to have fun and feel that they are part of the Percepto family.

Plus500 Careers
Loading
Plus500 Careers
Submit Your CV
Career WITH A PLUS
Check out our openings
About The Company
Plus500 is a global fintech company, listed on The London Stock Exchange and a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. The company is headquartered in Haifa, Israel, with offices in Tel Aviv, the UK, Cyprus, Australia, Seychelles, Singapore, Bulgaria, Estonia, the United States and Japan.
We focus on technology and most importantly, people. Our people are what makes Plus500 the global leader it is today. We are looking for great team players who are smart, curious, self-driven and who are willing to take risks.
Are you our Plus one?
Careers
Current Openings
Company’s Values
Technology Driven
Our state of the art technology is due to our creative and talented engineers.
Strive for Excellence
We don’t compromise on the talent of our employees and on the quality of our
product.
Keep it simple
Find the simplest and fastest way to solve any challenge you face.
Be Bold
Building great things means taking risks. We have a saying: “The riskiest thing is
to take no risks.” In a
world that’s changing so quickly, you’re guaranteed to fail if you don’t take any risks. We encourage
everyone
to make bold decisions, even if that means being wrong some of the time.
Check out our openings
Milestones
2008
The original Plus500 Group is founded, launching its first PC-based online trading platform.
2009
Plus500 begins its Affiliates Marketing program.
2010
Plus500 launches its first web app, providing trading access to Mac, Linux, and smartphone users.
Plus500 expands abroad, as subsidiary Plus500UK begins operations in London, England.
2011
Plus500 Group launches its first iPhone and iPad application.
Plus500 becomes the highest-rated CFD trading app on Apple's App Store.
2012
Plus500 Group brings its app to Android smartphones and tablets.
Plus500AU subsidiary begins operations in Sydney, Australia.
2013
Plus500 Ltd goes public on the London Stock Exchange.
2014
Plus500 enters the European market as Plus500CY subsidiary begins operations in Limassol, Cyprus.
2015
Plus500IL subsidiary begins operations in Tel Aviv, Israel.
Plus500 signs a sponsorship deal with Spanish football club Atlético de Madrid.
2016
Plus500BOS subsidiary begins operations in Sofia, Bulgaria.
Plus500 enters the New Zealand market.
2017
Plus500SG subsidiary begins operations in Singapore.
Plus500 enters the South African market.
Customer base reaches 10 million.
2018
Plus500 Ltd’s ordinary shares move to the London Stock Exchange’s Main Market for Listed Companies, joining the UK FTSE 250 index.
2019
Plus500 enhances trading platform with advanced analysis tools, including volume indicators and drawing features.
Plus500 adds 100+ new financial instruments, such as the Japan 225 Index and Crypto 10.
Plus500 upgrades WebApp interfaces, introducing a popular dark mode.
2020
Plus500 signs sponsorship agreements with football clubs BSC Young Boys, Atalanta B.C., and Legia Warsaw.
Plus500’s financial technology group defines a new vision for the company./li>
Plus500SEY begins operations in Victoria, Seychelles.
2021
Plus500 opens a new Research & Development facility in Tel Aviv.
Plus500Invest brings share trading to customers.
Plus500 completes its first acquisition deal of CTS and Cunningham Commodities and enters the American market.
Customer base reaches 20 million.
2022
Plus500 expands to the Japanese market.
Plus500 launches its new global branding campaign featuring Emmy award-winning actor, Kiefer Sutherland.
Plus500 begins Futures Trading operations in the U.S.
Plus500 signs sponsorship deal with the Chicago Bulls.
Plus500 proudly introduces +Insights, providing customers access to millions of trades, including performance and trends, in real time.
Regulatory license obtained in Estonia, establishing Plus500EE subsidiary.
2023
Plus500 launches ‘Plus500 Futures’, a new trading platform for retail customers to access the Futures market.
Plus500AE subsidiary begins operations in the United Arab Emirates.
Plus500BHS subsidiary begins operations in the Bahamas.
Plus500 launches Japanese trading platform tailored to the retail forex market.
2024
Plus500 secures clearing membership from EUREX, strengthening its derivatives market presence.
Plus500 launches ‘Plus500 COSMOS’, a new easy-to-use client portal serving B2B customers in the Futures market.
2025
Plus500 joins the STOXX Europe 600, a key European equity index.
Plus500 obtains new licenses for UAE under SCA, Indonesia under Bappebti and Canada under CIRO, expanding its presence in the Middle East, South Asian, and North American markets.
Plus500 obtains clearing membership with ICE Clear US, boosting its US market reach.
Plus500 debuts a multi-asset trading platform in Japan, broadening investor reach.
Plus500 enters Indian Futures market with acquisition of Mehta Equities.
Plus500 becomes the clearing partner for FanDuel Prediction Markets (CME Group event contracts).
Plus500 enters an exclusive clearing and technology partnership with Topstep.
All-time customer base reaches 30 million.
2026
Plus500 adds Prediction Markets to its U.S. trading platform, allowing customers to trade on global event outcomes.
All-time customer base reaches 33 million.

What You’ll Do:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines that integrate data from multiple sources, including APIs, databases, streaming platforms, edge computing devices, cloud services, and on-premise systems.
Design reliable and business-critical data processing workflows for batch and real-time use cases.
Develop data access services and APIs that enable efficient communication between edge devices, cloud infrastructure, and on-premise environments.
Design and optimize storage solutions for structured, semi-structured, and high-dimensional sensor data to support AI model training, inference, and analytics.
Strong understanding of distributed systems and scalable data processing architectures.
Build and maintain scalable streaming data pipelines for low-latency processing and event-driven architectures.
Analyze existing data architecture, storage models, and processing workflows, and continuously improve performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
Optimize cloud infrastructure and data storage costs while maintaining high availability and low-latency access.
Collaborate closely with Software, AI, Algorithms, DevOps, and Product teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Design monitoring, observability, and operational processes for data platforms.
What You Bring:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering or a related role.
Strong experience designing and implementing large-scale data pipelines using orchestration frameworks such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or similar.
5+ years of software development experience, including at least 2 years of Python development.
Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, ClickHouse, or similar technologies.
Experience designing and implementing streaming and event-driven data architectures using technologies such as AWS Kinesis, Amazon SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar messaging systems.
Experience designing REST APIs and backend services (FastAPI or similar frameworks).
Experience working with AWS cloud services (S3, EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).
Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering practices.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with engineering, AI, and Product teams.
Self-driven, innovative, and continuously looking for ways to improve systems and processes.
Great to Have:
Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
Experience with distributed computing platforms and distributed data processing systems.
Experience building ML data pipelines supporting training and inference workloads.
Experience working with large-scale sensor, IoT, or time-series data.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Kibana, or OpenSearch.
Experience working in edge computing or hybrid cloud environments.

Quantum Art.description:
Product Designer (UI/Visual)


TECHNICAL & MARKET ANALYSIS | Appended by Quantum.Jobs


The emergence of product designers specializing in visual interface design within the quantum software sector addresses a critical operational friction in translating complex algorithmic abstractions into accessible developer environments. As quantum development platforms advance from manual circuit assembly to high-level synthesis, the design layer acts as a primary bridge between expert quantum information scientists and non-specialist enterprise domain engineers. Visual product design in this context functions as an usability enablement layer, ensuring that complex mathematical constructs, logic gates, and optimization parameters are rendered intuitive for industrial adoption. Market indicators suggest that as deep-tech ventures transition from R&D exploratory phases to enterprise platform deployments, human-computer interaction (HCI) becomes a vital determinant of platform retention and ecosystem expansion. By abstracting the cognitive overhead inherent in low-level quantum programming, visual UI design accelerates the commercial viability of algorithm development suites across the broader software value chain.


Within the software layer of the quantum computing ecosystem, user interface and visual design function as essential adoption catalysts. As high-performance computing centers and enterprise software teams integrate quantum algorithms into classical IT architectures, the lack of standardized visual paradigms presents a barrier to entry. Non-expert developers frequently face steep learning curves when navigating complex circuit topologies, synthesis options, and execution telemetry.


Visual design systems resolve vendor fragmentation by providing consistent graphical frameworks for complex computational workflows. Sector-wide efforts continue to address talent and integration challenges in quantum systems by abstracting underlying physical constraints into coherent, enterprise-grade software interfaces. Without standardized visual interaction models, deep-tech platforms risk remaining constrained to niche academic user bases.


The alignment of design systems with technical architecture enables smoother human-in-the-loop validation of quantum circuits. Visual feedback loops allow software engineers to assess resource estimation, circuit depth, and gate counts prior to execution on QPU backends or classical simulators. This visual clarity directly mitigates configuration errors and improves developer velocity in complex hybrid workflows.


The technical capability architecture for this role type centers on translating abstract quantum concepts into structured visual design systems, design tokens, and scalable component libraries. Mastery of specialized design software, interactive prototyping, and data visualization frameworks is required to represent high-dimensional algorithmic data, probability distributions, and circuit diagrams clearly. Design practitioners must operate at the intersection of front-end component architecture, design system maintenance, and user workflow optimization. These technical capabilities directly enhance product usability and interface scalability. By maintaining cohesive design languages across desktop, web, and integrated development environments (IDEs), this function enables seamless developer navigation across disparate software tools. Furthermore, robust visual architecture facilitates efficient cross-functional collaboration between design, product management, and quantum engineering teams, ensuring that interface components accurately reflect underlying algorithmic functionalities without sacrificing clarity or system performance. - Accelerates the enterprise adoption of quantum software platforms by lowering visual and cognitive barriers for non-specialist developers

- Reduces configuration errors in complex algorithm construction through intuitive graphical representation of circuit logic

- Standardizes visual interaction paradigms across integrated development environments and web-based quantum portals

- Enhances cross-functional efficiency between quantum algorithm researchers and front-end engineering teams

- Streamlines human-in-the-loop verification processes for quantum circuit synthesis and resource estimation workflows

- Improves developer onboarding velocity across enterprise software teams adopting hybrid quantum-classical workflows

- Strengthens brand consistency and platform credibility across commercial software interfaces at Classiq Technologies

- Optimizes complex data visualization frameworks for QPU execution telemetry, gate counts, and error mitigation outputs

- Mitigates platform churn by delivering cohesive, accessible design systems tailored to deep-tech developer toolchains

- Facilitates the scaling of user interface components to accommodate rapidly evolving algorithmic design capabilities

- Supports ecosystem expansion by rendering abstract mathematical constructs accessible to enterprise domain experts

- Drives product usability parity between deep-tech quantum suites and modern classical enterprise software platformsIndustry Tags: Quantum Software UI, Product Design, Visual Design Systems, Developer Experience, Human-Computer Interaction, Deep Tech Enterprise Design, User Interface Design, Quantum Circuit Visualization, Classiq Technologies

Quantum Source.description:
Quantum Source is a novel key player at the forefront of the worldwide effort towards large-scale quantum computation. Based on proprietary technology, Quantum Source is developing a unique fault-tolerant compound photon–atom quantum computer.
We are a young, dynamic, and extraordinarily multidisciplinary company that combines the fields of quantum physics, optics, mechanical engineering, hardware, firmware, and software.
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Researcher to join the Applications Team within the Theory Group.
The Quantum Applications Team is responsible for exploring practical applications and quantum algorithms that leverage Quantum Source's fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) architecture — identifying high-impact use cases, developing and benchmarking quantum algorithms, and collaborating with industry and academic partners to demonstrate the advantage of our hardware.
As a Researcher on the team, your core focus will be quantum resource estimation — determining the runtime and physical footprint required to solve problems of practical significance on our hardware, for algorithms ranging from cryptanalysis to quantum simulation for chemistry and materials. Over time, you will help expand the team's application portfolio and demonstrate the advantages of Quantum Source's hardware across a growing range of use cases.
Quantum Source.title: Researcher – Quantum Applications Team, Theory Group

This role involves hands-on work across design, fabrication, and experimental characterization of integrated photonic devices, in close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.
Quantum Source.title: Senior Photonics Researcher

Questar Auto Technologies.description:
As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work with the latest technologies and contribute to a product that is making a tangible difference in people's lives and the environment.
Whether you are an engineer, data scientist, or sales professional, we are always looking for talented individuals who share our vision for a smarter and more efficient future in the automotive world.
Join us today and help us drive the industry forward!
Senior Data Scientist — Individual Contributor
Herzliya, Israel
Full Time
Experienced
Share
We are hiring a senior individual contributor to join our Data Science team. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take ownership of the full solution,  from understanding the problem and building the required data pipelines to developing the model, deploying it, and keeping it reliable in production. You should be comfortable working across data, code, infrastructure, and monitoring independently.
The domain is genuinely hard: noisy sensor and telemetry data, weak and delayed labels, enormous scale, and physical systems that fail in complicated ways.  We use whatever technique the problem calls for, from classical machine learning and survival analysis to our own patent-pending deep learning architectures and agentic flows already running in production.
The team moves quickly and operates with a startup mentality: high ownership, short decision paths, and a strong bias toward action. When we encounter a difficult problem, we do not stop at “we can’t.” We ask, “How can we?”
Moving fast does not mean cutting corners. It means combining resourcefulness and practical judgment with scientific rigor, engineering quality, and production reliability.
We also have proprietary methods for validating results against ground truth, so the feedback loop is real: when a solution works, it ships. You will see your work in production and understand its impact on real fleets. What you’ll do
Own projects end to end: stakeholder discussions, problem framing, data exploration, modeling, validation, deployment, and post-launch monitoring.
Turn ambiguous or partially defined business needs into clear, practical, and measurable solutions.
Build predictive and prescriptive models over large-scale vehicle telemetry, diagnostics, and fault data.
Design, build, and maintain scalable, reproducible, and well-tested data pipelines over billions of daily data points.
Build and operate the workflows required for training, validation, inference, and ongoing evaluation.
Take responsibility for getting solutions into production, including automated testing and deployment, environment configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Choose the right tool for each problem, from gradient boosting and survival analysis to deep architectures over raw signals—and clearly explain your decisions.
Design evaluations that reflect reality, use our proprietary validation methods, and challenge metrics that tell a comfortable but misleading story.
Develop and integrate agentic and LLM-based flows that explain findings, recommend actions, and build the relevant evals.
Investigate failures across data, models, workflows, and production systems.
Present findings, trade-offs, and results clearly to business stakeholders and executive leadership.
Raise the technical bar through reviews, mentorship, and shared standards, as a senior IC, not a people manager.
Qualifications
MSc in Computer Science or an engineering-related quantitative field, such as Electrical Engineering,  Statistics, Physics, or Applied Mathematics. A PhD is an advantage.
At least eight years of industry experience in a related data science or machine learning role.
Proven experience taking machine learning solutions to production, not only building prototypes and notebooks, but deploying, monitoring, maintaining, retraining, and troubleshooting what you shipped.
Strong experience building reliable, performant, and well-tested data pipelines over very large datasets.
Strong experience with Spark, distributed computing, SQL, and modern big data platforms. Databricks experience is a significant advantage.
Practical experience with automated testing and deployment, cloud-based systems, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
Experience delivering LLM or agentic applications to production, including evaluation, guardrails, and cost and latency trade-offs.
Strong foundations across statistics, experimental design, classical machine learning, and modern deep learning.
Excellent Python skills and fluency with PyTorch.
Demonstrated ability to work comfortably across data science, data engineering, model deployment, and production systems.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently, make sound decisions under ambiguity, and determine what should—and should not—be built.
A proactive and resourceful mindset. You naturally look for viable solutions rather than stopping at constraints.
Very good English communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to business stakeholders and C-level audiences.
Advantages
Experience in automotive, telematics, IoT, predictive maintenance, or industrial and physical systems.
Experience with anomaly detection, remaining useful life, or failure prediction using weak or delayed labels.
Experience designing and operating end-to-end machine learning systems.
What we offer
A fast-moving environment with a startup mentality and the scale, data, and customers required to create real impact.
A senior, high-caliber team that values initiative, pragmatism, versatility, and people who make things happen.
Broad ownership across data, modeling, deployment, and production systems.
Hard problems worth solving, with the freedom to challenge assumptions and find better approaches.
Work that reaches production and measurably reduces cost and downtime for fleets across four continents.
Who We Are

SciPlay.description:
We’re looking for a VIP Monetization Manager to join our team in a specialized role focused on Loyalty Feature, aiming to enhance the experience of our games’ most valuable players.
By developing a retention-focused strategy tailored to this key player segment, you’ll drive efforts to strengthen the connection between our games and their high-tier player base, creating an impactful and lasting bond.
In this role, you’ll manage the life cycle of top-tier players, elevating their in-game experience through innovative mechanics and features—driven by data, testing, and evaluation. You’ll work closely with Monetization, Product, and Analytics teams, making data-informed decisions on priorities for both the game team and VIP Account Managers to support the long-term growth of our high-value player tiers. This position offers high-impact potential and a unique blend of creative and analytical skills for the right candidate.

Key responsibilities:
  • Leverage strong numerical and data analysis skills to drive business-oriented decisions, supported by insightful reporting and trend analysis
  • Analyze information effectively, drawing actionable conclusions to optimize player engagement and retention strategies
  • Collaborate with multiple interfaces across the organization, partnering with cross-functional teams to influence outcomes and align goals
  • Demonstrate a proactive, solution-oriented approach—able to tackle challenges and drive initiatives forward
  • Exhibit teamwork and a passion for growth, contributing actively to team objectives and culture
  • Communicate clearly and confidently in English, both written and verbal, ensuring ideas and insights are well understood
  • Maintain a focus on consumer behavior, particularly in digital entertainment and gaming, as an advantage

Requirements:
  • Strong skills in numbers, business orientation, reports, and data analysis - a must
  • 2+ Years’ experience as a Product Manager/ Monetization Management in B2C; Gaming, Social/Mobile, Casino preferred
  • Self-motivated and PROACTIVE go-getter who is results-driven and has shown a track record of achievement through creativity – a must!
  • Exemplary communication skills in both written and spoken English – a must
SciPlay.title: VIP Monetization Manager

SciPlay.description:
We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer with strong product thinking and a passion for developer experience. In this role, you will design, build, and evolve internal platform capabilities that support game development teams, working across infrastructure, backend services, and tooling. You will collaborate with multiple teams to identify friction points, improve workflows, and deliver scalable, reliable solutions.
This position requires a hands-on engineer who can balance quick wins with long-term improvements, take ownership, and drive impact across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, build, and maintain internal developer platform capabilities (CI/CD, environments, observability, infrastructure).
  • Identify and resolve developer pain points through data, feedback, and hands-on investigation.
  • Develop shared services, tools, and components to improve development speed and quality.
  • Promote engineering excellence, including reliability, automation, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and drive improvements.
  • Own operational aspects of systems, including monitoring, SLIs/SLOs, and on-call participation.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and long-term platform strategy.


Requirements:
  • 5–10+ years of software engineering experience (platform, infrastructure, or DevOps focus).
  • Strong product mindset with a passion for improving developer experience.
  • Experience building and operating distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (C#, Go, Python, or Typescript).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.


Nice to Have:
  • Experience working with game development teams.
  • Background in internal developer platforms or large-scale tooling.
  • Knowledge of security, compliance, or platform governance.
SciPlay.title: Senior Platform Engineer

SciPlay.description:
The Assistant Controller will play a key role in supporting the Finance team across a broad range of accounting, reporting, and operational activities for the US and Israeli business units, collaborating closely with the accounting team to identify opportunities for process improvements and enhance efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly detail-oriented and proactive in supporting the team.

 

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and record monthly journal entries for general ledger posting and perform related account reconciliations 
  • Assist with the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, working closely with the Finance leadership team
  • Maintain the general ledger accounts for the respective legal entities, reporting discrepancies, imbalances, and other issues to the corporate finance team
  • Work with both internal and external auditors during the annual audit process, preparing the necessary supporting workpapers and schedules
  • Serve as the main point of contact for business owners to ensure accurate and timely invoicing through Oracle modules
  • Ensure compliance with internal control frameworks and regulatory requirements, with the support of Corporate Finance
  • Assist in the preparation and review of tax filings and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Prepare and monitor weekly cash flow reports
  • Collaborate with the U.S. Finance team to perform account reconciliations, resolve discrepancies, and support reporting requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes through automation and AI-driven tools.
  • Manage ad-hoc special projects as required

 

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, with CPA certification
  • 2+ years of progressive experience in general accounting and finance.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. and Israeli GAAP
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, conditional formulas, etc.)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Hebrew
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, unsupervised environment
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously within deadlines in a technology-driven setting
  • Ability to optimize processes and improve workflows
  • Service-oriented with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of personnel
  • Proven problem-solving skills and strong analytical thinking
  • A team player with a proactive approach
SciPlay.title: Assistant Controller

SciPlay.description:
* This role requires relocation to the United States following an initial transition period in Israel.

The VP Monetization serves as the studio’s senior monetization advisor and subject matter expert, partnering closely with game leadership teams to maximize business performance and player value. This role provides strategic guidance, data-driven insights, industry expertise, and monetization best practices to help solve complex business challenges and identify growth opportunities across the portfolio

Key Responsibilities:
  •  Serve as the studio’s subject matter expert on monetization, providing strategic guidance and thought leadership across multiple games and products.
  • Partner with game leadership teams to identify monetization opportunities, diagnose complex business challenges, and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Support product, economy, and LiveOps teams in evaluating monetization strategies, pricing approaches, player segmentation, and offer design.
  • Leverage analytics, experimentation results, player behavior insights, and market trends to provide actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
  • Identify cross-portfolio monetization best practices and drive knowledge sharing across game teams.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and monitor industry trends to uncover new opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • Influence decision-making through expertise, insights, and strong stakeholder partnerships while empowering game teams to own and execute their strategies.
  • Develop frameworks, methodologies, and tools that help teams make more effective monetization decisions.
  • Mentor and support product, economy, and monetization professionals across the organization.


Requirements:
  • Significant experience in Monetization, Product, Economy, Growth, or related leadership roles within gaming or a data-driven consumer business.
  • Deep understanding of free-to-play monetization, game economies, LiveOps, and experimentation.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with a proven track record of driving business growth.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
SciPlay.title: VP Monetization

SciPlay.description:
The VP Product role is a strategic product leadership position focused on supporting and aligning roadmap direction across multiple teams and product domains within the studio organization. The role partners closely with product leaders, game teams, and business stakeholders to ensure product initiatives align with company goals, player needs, and long-term business strategy.

This position focuses on shaping product strategy, driving roadmap alignment across multiple teams, and partnering with studio leadership to support long-term business growth and player experience. The role works cross-functionally with product, LiveOps, monetization, and development teams to help guide strategic priorities, evaluate opportunities, and ensure product initiatives align with overall business objectives.

Key responsibilities :

  • Driving strategic alignment across product roadmaps and initiatives
  • Supporting prioritization and investment decisions based on business impact and player value
  • Partnering with studio and product leadership to shape long-term product direction
  • Using data and performance insights to guide roadmap recommendations and feature strategy
  • Facilitating cross-team collaboration and organizational alignment
  • Influencing decision-making across multiple stakeholders in a matrix environment
  • The role requires strong business acumen, strategic thinking, communication skills, and the ability to influence without direct authority in a fast-paced, data-driven gaming environment

Requirements :

  • Significant experience in Product or related leadership roles within gaming or a highly data-driven consumer business.
  • Deep understanding of product, player behavior, and experimentation frameworks.
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to evaluate opportunities and guide product-related decisions across multiple products.
  • Experience partnering with senior product, game, and studio leaders to influence strategy and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and performance insights to identify growth opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Proven ability to drive alignment, influence stakeholders, and operate effectively in a matrix organization without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
SciPlay.title: VP Product

SciPlay.description:
We are looking for a talented and a Monetization Manager to join our team.
The Monetization team is responsible for driving revenue growth and providing the best game experience to our users. To achieve company business goals, the team constantly optimizes the game experience and performance based on data.
As part of your role, you'll manage a full-cycle campaign calendar, including planning short & long-term activities, defining goals, executing, and analyzing performance. Possess a deep understanding of existing game mechanics and how to best utilize them within Monetization tools.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop quarterly, monthly, and weekly promotional plans according to the monetization strategy
  • In charge of the implementation of promotions through the campaign design and creative creation in all communication channels
  • Responsible for the operational launch of campaigns, QA, monitoring results, reacting accordingly, analyzing the campaigns, and bringing insights for optimization
  • Leverage product features and marketing tools for driving revenue growth and providing a good game experience to our players
  • Constantly coming up with exciting new innovative ideas.
  • Constantly improving and optimizing in a data-driven manner the game experience and performance in order to hit the company KPIs.
  • Collaborate with the creative team, operations team, game economy team, BA, and product managers in order to execute in-game events & promotions.
Requirements:
  • 2+ years of experience working as a monetization live-ops/ CRM manager in a gaming company OR 2+ years of experience in a similar role (Product Marketing, Branding, Growth Manager, etc.) in a B2C company.
  • Strong English written/verbal communication skills
  • Outstanding creativity, drive, and data orientation
  • Strong sense of responsibility and professionalism
  • Attention to detail with an eye for aesthetics
  • A people person, positive, initiator, curious, independent, and a quick learner
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work well independently or within a team environment
  • Experience with planning in-app campaign calendar
  • Working closely with all teams in executing in-app promotions (Creative, BA, Product, Economy)
SciPlay.title: Monetization Manager

SciPlay.description:
The Head of Monetization & Economy is responsible for driving the business optimization, monetization models, and game economy strategy across the studio’s portfolio—featuring one live product and two upcoming games in the pre-scale phase. This role is a unique blend of highly analytical business strategy and a deep commitment to the player experience. You will be hands-on in crafting the game economy, while managing and leading the LiveOps and monetization operations functions. By collaborating closely with Product, Creative, and LiveOps teams, you will champion out-of-the-box thinking and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to deliver sustainable growth, compelling in-game campaigns, and an unforgettable player journey.
Key Responsibilities
  • Business & Monetization Strategy: Drive the commercial success of our games by optimizing business models, monetization strategies, and revenue streams, ensuring a balance between high profitability and excellent player retention.
  • Hands-on Economy Design: Take a deeply hands-on approach to building, balancing, and optimizing the game economy and math models. Design the delicate balance of difficulty curves versus reward systems to maximize engagement.
  • Player Experience & Product Collaboration: Share the burden of the overall player experience. Collaborate closely with the Product department to spec features that support monetization, shape the creative direction, and design compelling in-game campaigns and events.
  • LiveOps & Configuration Management: Manage and lead the LiveOps and monetization operations function (including configuration specialists). Oversee the end-to-end execution of events, A/B tests, and economy updates to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Scaling & Launch: Build the foundational economy frameworks for two games currently in the launch/pre-scale phase, driving them from soft launch to successful global scale.
  • Innovation & AI Adoption: Act as a pioneer in adopting new technologies. Leverage AI tools and out-of-the-box thinking to optimize economy balancing, automate workflows, and uncover new monetization opportunities.
  • Data & Experimentation: Analyze player behavior and economy health. Define experimentation strategies and run A/B tests to continuously optimize both business KPIs and player satisfaction.
Requirements
  • Must: 5+ years of experience in Game Economy, Monetization, Product Management, or LiveOps within the gaming industry.
  • Must: Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and balancing complex game economies, math models, and progression systems.
  • Must: Demonstrated experience managing employees and leading operational functions (LiveOps, monetization ops, or configuration teams).
  • Strong understanding of the holistic player experience, including difficulty tuning, reward loops, and the impact of creative assets on player behavior.
  • Strong strategic and business acumen, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business and product decisions.
  • A forward-thinking mindset with a demonstrated passion for exploring and adopting AI tools and innovative tech in day-to-day work.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with Product, R&D, and Creative teams.
  • Advantage: Experience with Ad-driven Free-to-Play business models (Ad-Monetization, Rewarded Video, Interstitials) and mediation platforms.
SciPlay.title: Head of monetization and Economy

SuperPlay.description:
Careers Position - SuperPlay
Back
Head of BI
Tel-Aviv, Israel
Full-time
Description
Come and join a rapidly expanding mobile games company!
Who are we?
SuperPlay is a leading gaming company dedicated to creating unforgettable mobile gaming experiences. Founded in 2019 by industry experts from Playtika and Rovio, the company strives to develop innovative and exciting casual games that captivate millions of players worldwide and remain enjoyable for years to come.
Dice Dreams, our flagship game, has become a global sensation and a top-100-grossing hit, while Domino Dreams, our next big success, is also making a significant impact in the industry.
Our Newest Game – A Magical Collaboration with Disney!
Released in 2025, Disney Solitaire brings beloved Disney stories and characters to life in an unforgettable gaming experience.
Our team, headquartered in Tel Aviv, is made up of talented, passionate, and ambitious professionals. And the future is even more exciting! Want to be part of our journey? Check out the job description below.
What will you do at SuperPlay?
We are looking for a visionary Head of BI to lead our data strategy, focusing on high-volume data architecture, advanced AI tooling, and empowering the organization with cutting-edge data capabilities.
You will:
Lead & Scale: Lead, manage, and grow teams of data engineers and BI developers.
Drive Strategy: Collaborate with cross-functional leadership to define and implement our overarching data strategy, policies, data governance, and processes.
Empower the Business: Drive the use of data and analytics to inform high-level business decisions, providing scalable reporting and insights on media acquisition channels, user usage, and business metrics.
Ensure Excellence: Maintain impeccable data quality and accuracy through continuous monitoring, auditing, and architectural improvements of data management processes.
Champion AI & Data Literacy: Create and maintain a data-driven culture by promoting data literacy, self-serve analytics, and smart automation tools throughout the organization.
Innovate: Stay on the bleeding edge of data trends and technologies, continuously assessing and implementing new tools to keep our stack world-class.
Who are you?
Seniority: 7+ years of experience in BI and data, including at least 3 years in a leadership role.
Scale & Volume: Proven experience working with massive scale, high-volume data (B2C, mobile apps, gaming, or ad-tech preferred).
Leadership: Proven experience managing and mentoring data engineers and BI developers.
AI-Forward: Hands-on experience building self-service data tools powered by automation and AI-driven workflows.
Technical Chops: Expertise in SQL, proficiency in Python for data engineering, and a strong background in data visualization architecture.
Cloud Native: Experience with cloud-based data management and analytics tools (experience with modern cloud data warehouses is a plus).
Strategic Communication: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into insights business leaders can act on.
You get bonus points for:
AI Tooling: Claude Code + Cursor with full data MCP access and skill-sets
Data warehouse: BigQuery
Visualization and dashboards: Looker, Mixpanel
ETL: DBT, Airflow
Does this describe you perfectly?
Apply now!
-->
Good luck Raz! We’re behind you!

Voyantis.description:
Description
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the design and implementation of next-generation AI solutions for Lifecycle Marketing.
As a senior member of our team, you will shape methodology, guide product direction under uncertainty, and represent Voyantis in high-stakes conversations with customers. You’ll combine deep expertise in causal inference, reinforcement learning, and experimentation with strong communication skills to drive impact across the company and with our clients.
About Us
Voyantis was founded in 2020 on the premise that market fundamentals are shifting companies worldwide from growth-at-all-costs strategies to efficient and responsible growth practices, with a focus on improving Unit Economics. With a bold mission to leverage AI to reimagine the whole Growth process, to streamline this transition and ensure its sustainability, Voyantis eliminates the guesswork from customer value creation, empowering leaders with actionable strategies and tactics to acquire, nurture and retain the high-value customers their businesses really need, with the actions and the timing that would be most impactful to achieve their goals.
Leading companies like Miro, Rappi and Moneylion rely on Voyantis to effectively apply these predictions. They use Voyantis to drive high-value customer acquisition on platforms like Google and Meta, optimize incentives through Salesforce and Braze, and perfectly time upsells, resulting in a 20%-40% ROI uplift.
Voyantis is well-backed by top VCs such as Target Global and SquarePeg. The company has tripled in size annually over the past two years and now boasts a team of 100 with offices in California, New York and Tel Aviv.
Responsibilities
Own the design and methodology of data science solutions for lifecycle marketing, with emphasis on causal inference, uplift modeling, and reinforcement learning.
Lead the development of experimentation frameworks (A/B/n tests, variance reduction, policy evaluation).
Research, prototype, and productionize multi-armed bandits and contextual RL approaches for personalization and timing optimization.
Take a strong, opinionated role in brainstorming sessions, guiding decision-making in areas of high uncertainty.
Represent Voyantis in front of customers, translating complex modeling decisions into clear business value.
Mentor junior and mid-level team members, raising the technical bar across the team.
Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and analysts to align data science strategy with business goals.
Requirements
M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field.
6+ years of hands-on data science experience, including direct work with lifecycle marketing, personalization, or customer analytics.
Advanced expertise in statistics, causal inference, and experimental design.
Proven track record of implementing reinforcement learning / multi-armed bandit models in production.
Strong software engineering skills in Python, SQL, and ML frameworks
Exceptional communication skills — able to influence internal teams and present to executive-level customers.
Entrepreneurial mindset: thrives in uncertainty, challenges assumptions, and pushes for impactful solutions.

Responsibilities
Dive deep into massive enterprise-scale telemetry and workload datasets to uncover patterns, optimize cloud execution, and steer core product decisions.
Design, build, and maintain production-grade data pipelines, analytics models, and internal platforms supporting real-time autonomous systems.
Partner directly with engineering and leadership to translate complex multi-cloud performance metrics into actionable platform intelligence .
Develop robust data modeling frameworks, statistical analyses, and high-impact visual interfaces to measure system efficiency and model accuracy.
What We Offer
Top-of-Market Compensation: Highly competitive base salary benchmarking top-tier startup talent.
Significant Equity: Meaningful early-stage equity grants positioned above market standard.
Pure Technical Impact: High agency, zero bureaucracy, and direct ownership over core data infrastructure.
Ready to shape the data engine behind autonomous AI workloads? Hit Apply.
Requirements
3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics / Product Analytics (relevant elite military tech unit experience strongly counts).
Advanced, production-level SQL and strong scripting/analytical capabilities in Python .
